title: Brewfather Ingredient Stock Low
app: Brewfather batch exports, iSpindel and Tilt hydrometers, ESPHome mash probes, keg pressure sensors, brew-fridge telemetry, and cellar climate data via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=brew:batch event=inventory
| stats latest(days_of_stock_left) as days_of_stock_left by ingredient
| where days_of_stock_left<14
| sort days_of_stock_left
description: Uses Brewfather inventory exports telemetry to monitor which ingredients are close to running out in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for brew-day surprises caused by low stock, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Brewfather inventory exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Ingredient table of days of stock left.
grandmaExplanation: It blends which ingredients are close to running out so you can spot brew-day surprises caused by low stock before it becomes annoying.
